citizenship_rule_text: U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident
eligible_years_text: Undergraduates and qualifying recent graduates; see DOE eligibility rules
graduation_rule_text: Associate's, bachelor's, and combined BS/MS graduates may qualify when the degree-to-start interval is no more than two years.
raw_eligibility_text: U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident; age 18 or older; full-time undergraduate at an accredited community, two-year, or four-year institution with at least one matriculated semester, 6 STEM credits, 12 total credits, and cumulative GPA 3.0; qualifying recent graduates within two years are also eligible.
other_rule_text: Age >= 18; at least one matriculated semester; >= 6 STEM and >= 12 total undergraduate credits; GPA >= 3.0; participation and application limits apply.

eligible_years_text: College, graduate, and professional students; undergraduates eligible
graduation_rule_text: Graduating undergraduates may qualify when accepted into an accredited graduate program for fall.
raw_eligibility_text: U.S. citizen or permanent resident; at least age 18 by the stated cycle date, with a limited nearby-campus exception for some graduating high-school seniors; enrolled at least half-time in an accredited community college, college, university, graduate, or professional program, or accepted into an accredited graduate program for fall.
other_rule_text: Permanent residents must attend or be accepted by a U.S. educational institution; full-time summer research schedule.

eligible_years_text: College students; project-specific requirements
graduation_rule_text: Recent graduates may apply for the three internship sessions immediately following graduation.
raw_eligibility_text: U.S. citizen; cumulative GPA 3.0; at least age 16; full- or part-time college student in a degree-granting program at a U.S. Department of Education accredited institution. Recent graduates may apply for internships in the three sessions immediately following graduation.
other_rule_text: Age >= 16; GPA >= 3.0; course of study must align with NASA needs.

eligible_years_text: Undergraduate; cycle-specific
raw_eligibility_text: U.S. citizen or permanent resident; full-time undergraduate at an accredited U.S. two-year or four-year college; first-year undergraduates and graduating seniors are eligible; age 18 or older; background check and health insurance required.
other_rule_text: Age >= 18; background check, health insurance, direct deposit, and full-time participation required.

citizenship_rule_text: U.S. citizen; permanent residents considered at some labs
eligible_years_text: Sophomore, junior, senior, and graduate students in relevant majors
raw_eligibility_text: U.S. citizen, with permanent resident status considered at some laboratories; sophomore, junior, senior, or graduate student enrolled at a participating university in a major relevant to participating laboratory research.
other_rule_text: Permanent-resident eligibility is laboratory-specific; new undergraduate stipend tier expects at least 31 credits by the end of spring.

citizenship_rule_text: Enrollment-based eligibility; applicants from eligible North American/British/Irish universities
eligible_years_text: Undergraduates in qualifying degree programs; generally ≥2 years completed by internship
graduation_rule_text: Must maintain undergraduate status after the internship.
raw_eligibility_text: Undergraduate in a four-year program at a U.S., Canadian, U.K., or Irish institution in an eligible field; at least two years of the degree completed by the internship; must retain undergraduate status afterward. International students must have studied at an eligible institution for more than 12 months by the deadline.
other_rule_text: Eligible institution countries and fields apply; international students need >12 months at an eligible institution; special six-year residence rule for German citizens.

eligible_years_text: Undergraduates; host and program rules apply
graduation_rule_text: At least one undergraduate semester must remain at the start of the summer program.
raw_eligibility_text: Documented U.S. citizen, non-citizen national, or permanent resident; full-time enrollment at an accredited U.S. or territorial college or university; GPA 3.0 or better; at least two semesters completed and one undergraduate semester remaining by summer; committed interest in Ph.D. or MD-Ph.D. study.
other_rule_text: GPA >= 3.0; intended for Ph.D. or MD-Ph.D., not professional-practice degrees.

eligible_years_text: Four-year college students enrolled the following fall; preference for sophomores/juniors
graduation_rule_text: Must be enrolled in a four-year college in the fall after the program; graduating seniors are ineligible.
raw_eligibility_text: U.S. citizen or permanent resident; enrolled in a four-year college for the fall after the program; graduating seniors ineligible. Prior research is not required, with preference for students who completed sophomore or junior year.
other_rule_text: Preference, not a hard requirement, for students who completed sophomore or junior year; full 10-week commitment.

citizenship_rule_text: International students eligible; see current application rules
eligible_years_text: College sophomores and juniors
raw_eligibility_text: College sophomores and juniors in the life or physical sciences; international students are eligible.

eligible_years_text: Undergraduates; current eligibility rules apply
graduation_rule_text: Must return to an undergraduate degree program after summer.
raw_eligibility_text: Current sophomores and juniors are eligible; exceptional first-year students with prior independent research may be considered; participants must return to an undergraduate degree program after summer. Students of any nationality may apply, subject to stated U.S.-institution or partner-institution rules for international students.
other_rule_text: First-year eligibility is exceptional and requires prior independent research; international eligibility depends on institution/partner conditions.

eligible_years_text: Students entering final undergraduate year after the summer
graduation_rule_text: Must enter the final undergraduate year or academic term after the summer program.
raw_eligibility_text: U.S. citizen or permanent resident; enrolled undergraduate entering the final year or semester/quarter of study after summer.

eligible_years_text: Early undergraduates; designed for students not yet entering third year and with limited research experience
raw_eligibility_text: Must have graduated high school, not yet entered the third undergraduate year, and be enrolled or planning to enroll in a two- or four-year institution; age 16 or older. International students are not accepted. Prior research is not required.
other_rule_text: Age >= 16; applicants must not yet have entered their third undergraduate year.

citizenship_rule_text: International students not eligible for 2026 program
eligible_years_text: Undergraduates at 2- or 4-year colleges; see cycle rules
raw_eligibility_text: Incoming or current undergraduate enrolled or planning to enroll in a two- or four-year institution; age 18 or older. International students are not accepted. No prior research experience is required.

eligible_years_text: Non-BU rising sophomores/juniors/seniors; some tracks emphasize rising juniors/seniors
raw_eligibility_text: Non-Boston University undergraduates who will be rising juniors or rising seniors are eligible for the described SURF tracks.
other_rule_text: Class-year booleans use application-time standing: rising junior corresponds to current sophomore and rising senior to current junior; BU students are ineligible.

citizenship_rule_text: NSF REU eligibility typically U.S. citizen/PR; verify current cycle
eligible_years_text: Undergraduate; non-BU students
raw_eligibility_text: Non-Boston University undergraduate students; U.S. citizen or permanent resident.
other_rule_text: Boston University students are ineligible; official page does not state hard class-year, GPA, or prior-research requirements.

eligible_years_text: STEM majors at 2- and 4-year colleges; non-BU students
graduation_rule_text: Must not graduate before December of the program year.
raw_eligibility_text: U.S. citizen or permanent resident; STEM major at a two- or four-year college; currently enrolled undergraduate who has completed at least the first year and will not graduate before December of the program year. Boston University undergraduates are ineligible.
other_rule_text: BU undergraduates are ineligible; full 10-week participation required.

eligible_years_text: Four-year college; sophomore/junior/non-graduating senior
graduation_rule_text: Must return in fall 2026 to continue undergraduate studies
institution_type_rule_text: Enrollment in a four-year U.S. college or university including Puerto Rico and U.S. territories
raw_eligibility_text: U.S. citizen or permanent resident; enrolled at a four-year institution; sophomore junior or returning non-graduating senior; minimum 3.2 GPA; freshmen and community-college students ineligible
other_rule_text: Previous Amgen Scholars are ineligible

eligible_years_text: Four-year college; sophomore/junior/non-graduating senior
graduation_rule_text: Must return in fall after SSRP to continue undergraduate studies
institution_type_rule_text: Enrollment in an accredited four-year U.S. college or university including Puerto Rico and U.S. territories
raw_eligibility_text: U.S. citizen or permanent resident; enrolled at an accredited four-year institution; sophomore junior or returning non-graduating senior; minimum 3.2 GPA
other_rule_text: Interest in pursuing a Ph.D. or in exceptional cases an M.D./Ph.D.

eligible_years_text: Four-year college; sophomore/junior/non-graduating senior
graduation_rule_text: Must return in fall 2026 to continue undergraduate studies
institution_type_rule_text: Enrollment in an accredited four-year U.S. college or university including Puerto Rico and U.S. territories
raw_eligibility_text: U.S. citizen or permanent resident; enrolled at an accredited four-year institution; sophomore junior or returning non-graduating senior; minimum 3.2 GPA
other_rule_text: Interest in pursuing a Ph.D. or M.D./Ph.D. in biotechnology or related biomedical sciences

citizenship_rule_text: Primarily U.S. citizens/permanent residents; exceptions may require outside funding
eligible_years_text: Undergraduates; see project-specific eligibility
raw_eligibility_text: Open to undergraduates at two- and four-year institutions; core funding is primarily for U.S. citizens and permanent residents. The official FAQ describes limited, funding-dependent exceptions for some international students and graduates. Significant prior ecological research is not required, though individual projects may add requirements.
other_rule_text: International and post-graduation participation is funding-dependent and uncommon; project-specific requirements and full-program availability apply.

citizenship_rule_text: Foreign students may be eligible if studying in the U.S.; verify current cycle
eligible_years_text: Undergraduates; graduating seniors may be eligible
graduation_rule_text: For 2026, recent graduates with a bachelor's degree received no earlier than December 2025 were eligible.
raw_eligibility_text: Students enrolled in or just completing a bachelor's degree; recent graduates whose degree falls within the cycle's stated window are eligible. International students are eligible only when studying in the United States; foreign students at foreign institutions are not eligible. Minimum age 18.
other_rule_text: International applicants must study in the U.S.; age >= 18; strong mathematics background expected.

eligible_years_text: Undergraduates; current REU eligibility rules apply
graduation_rule_text: Must not graduate before the end of the REU.
raw_eligibility_text: U.S. citizen or permanent resident; active undergraduate at a U.S. or foreign university; must not graduate before the end of the program. The program primarily admits juniors, some exceptional sophomores, and does not usually admit first-years.
other_rule_text: Junior/sophomore/first-year language is selection preference rather than a hard exclusion; no other job or summer-class commitment allowed.

eligible_years_text: Undergraduates enrolled at U.S. institutions; see current cycle
raw_eligibility_text: U.S. citizen or permanent resident currently enrolled in an undergraduate degree program at a U.S. college or university.
